sections.title: Crossing to another vehicle
sections.content: átszáll ("to transfer, change vehicles") is built the same way as felszáll and leszáll — át- means "across, over" — and it takes the same -ra/-re you already use for getting on: átszállok a hármas villamosra ("I transfer onto tram number 3"). Name where with -nál/-nél: a Deák térnél szállok át ("I transfer at Deák Square").

items.spanish: A Blaha Lujza térnél átszállok a négyes villamosra.
items.english: At Blaha Lujza Square I transfer onto tram number 4.

items.spanish: Hol kell átszállni a hármas metróra?
items.english: Where do I need to transfer to metro line 3?

sections.content: át- shows up in lots of everyday verbs once you know to look for it: átmegy ("go across"), átad ("hand over"). Here it just means moving from one line to another — think of squeezing "across" from one vehicle to the next.
